The outlaws of the {wiki:Outlaw Camp} are going through hard times and their leader, {npc:Rottin Wood}, needs help: getting rabbit's foot "lucky charms", repairing the camp walls and ambushing merchants crossing the forest. You earn gold, experience, the achievements Merry Adventures and Bunny Slipped and, in the daily tasks, a chance to receive a {item:Time Ring} or a {item:Hunting Horn}.
Rottin Wood's daily tasks (Lucky Loop and Handyman)
After the missions: ask {npc:Rottin Wood} for them with {key:task} ({key:lucky charms} or {key:repairs}).
They give experience and gold; Lucky Loop also gives a chance of a {item:Time Ring} (9%) or a {item:Hunting Horn} (about 1%).
